summary: Round 2 passes with no open finding. The revision d77957f9 closes F1 with a Manifest job values table that pins all StorytimeJob fields for the 19 rows and an FR-5 test item. The table matches the card delivery manifest record for l2-w07-card-teddy. F2 is closed: FR-12 now permits the phrase "the approved Storytime Muse path", and the Overview uses that phrase. F3 is closed: the judge input states that the tool reads the card costs.tsv and writes no cost file. The revision adds no new open decision.

paraphrase.proposes: The track draws 19 color pictures for Storytime Level 2 family words. Eighteen new rows use the Storytime Muse color path and the frozen Sonnet judge at card size. The family row reuses the color print of the card track. The track delivers 1500 x 1500 PNG files named l2-w0N-card-<word>-v1.png to the handoff folder, with manifest.json, MANIFEST.txt (SHA-256), and a contact sheet. The work stays inside the remaining 0.86 USD of the 1.60 USD card limit and reports one status line to the PM by 2026-11-10.
paraphrase.current_system: The current system has the Storytime Muse path in scripts/storytime-muse.mjs and one guard module, scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs. That module owns CARD_RUN: cap 1.60 USD, start 2026-11-06, 3 tries, and the card Muse folder. It classifies each spec outDir and checks spend and tries before each provider call. scripts/storytime-judge-batch.mjs builds judge batches from a spec folder, and it has a --cards mode. src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts holds writeMuseDelivery for list rows with color and line prints, and deliverMuseCover for one cover entry. The new writer builds one StorytimeJob per row from the pinned Manifest job values table, because the 18 new ids are not list rows.
